name: TOA Paint (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: TOA Paint (Thailand) Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes paints and chemicals in Thailand, Vietnam, Laos, Myanmar, Cambodia, Indonesia, and Malaysia. The company offers construction chemicals, special paints, and hardware and power tools, as well as decorative, wood, and heavy duty coatings. TOA Paint (Thailand) Public Company Limited was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Bang Sao Thong, Thailand.
